meta.title: Guess the world machine data
meta.missing: null means no estimate for that country and year
meta.world_series: Gapminder's own world totals and averages (global files); CO₂ world value is Our World in Data's 'World' row

sources.name: Our World in Data CO₂ and greenhouse gas emissions

meta.honesty: All values are estimates. Figures before about 1950 are reconstructed by historians and statisticians from scattered records and are much less certain. Recent years can include Gapminder's short-term projections. Countries are shown with today's borders, which were different in the past.

gdp.name: Income per person
gdp.unit: $ per person per year (GDP per capita, PPP, constant 2021 international $)

co2.name: CO₂ per person
co2.unit: tonnes of CO₂ per person per year (territorial, fossil fuels and industry)
co2.note: Global Carbon Project data processed by Our World in Data; matched to Gapminder countries by ISO alpha-3 code.
